{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check for -1 in customer_age
age_silents = (data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {age_silents}")

# Check revenue format
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
print(f"Sample of cleaned revenue: {data['revenue_clean'].sample(5).values}")

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded = data[data['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded)}")"}
